reviews.name: Scott Mulvaney
reviews.text: Just got back from SYB Bali and had an absolute blast. Good times, good people and such a blast exploring with like minded people. Adventures daily. Delicious food. And a squad to explore all things Bali…. Aw what a dream come true. Well done SurfYogaBeer and can’t wait to do another!

reviews.name: Hannah Kerin
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience with Surf Yoga Beer Bali. This trip exceeded every expectation — I met 25 incredible people who quickly became friends, and the entire vibe was fun, welcoming, and unforgettable.

The itinerary was packed with once-in-a-lifetime experiences. The boat day was a highlight — snorkeling alongside manta rays and sea turtles was surreal. We also went ATV riding and white water rafting through the jungle, which was such an adrenaline rush. Nights out at Finns were a blast, and yes… plenty of tequila involved 🍹

I loved that the trip balanced adventure with wellness. The Pilates class and athletic conditioning sessions were great, and of course, surfing was such a fun challenge and a huge highlight.

Everything was so well organized, and the mix of activities made it the perfect blend of adventure, fitness, and social fun. I would 100% recommend this trip to anyone looking for a unique, active, and social travel experience — I’m already thinking about the next one!

reviews.name: Kirsty Cowie
reviews.text:
My journey with SurfYogaBeer (SYB) started in 2019 when I joined a trip to the Philippines. I had just quit my job and I was supposed to go Bali with a friend, but at the last minute she pulled out. I now needed a Plan B.

I spoke with one of my friends who recommended SYB and a few days later I was flying solo to the Philippines. Mantas (the founder) would say this was a Don't Think Just Do Moment!!

Before my trip to the Philippines I had never travelled alone before. I was confident that I would have a good time, but what I couldn't have foreseen where the friends I would make. The group was small (approx. 25 people) and I met one of my best friends there. We have since travelled together to several different countries including NICARAGUA!!

I write NICARAGUA in all caps, because I loved this SYB destination so much - I ended up moving there for 2.5 years after the trip (lol). SYB literally changed my life. I learnt to surf, which is now one of my biggest passions, lived in a surf community and met some pretty extraordinary people.

The leaders at SYB, especially the founders and leaders Mantas & Steph, work hard to make sure that these trips aren't only a good time for a week but that you make connections that will stay with you a very long time (hopefully a life time). Thank you guys x10000 for starting company. Can't wait to see more of the world with you.
